# qrcode.js

Vendored from [kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) `js/dist/qrcode.js`.

MIT License. Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. The full text is in `LICENSE-qrcode.txt`.

The search page and each permalink load this file from the site itself. The WeChat QR code is drawn on a canvas in the browser. Nothing is sent to a QR service.
